question: As an exponent of Khayal, Pandit Bhimsen Joshi belonged to which music Gharana?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Kirana__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pandit Bhimsen Joshi is a renowned figure in the world of Indian classical music, celebrated for his contributions to the Khayal genre.
 
• He belonged to the Kirana Gharana, which is known for its emphasis on the emotional expression in music, detailed alap (improvisation), and slow tempo renditions.
 
• The Kirana Gharana, to which Pandit Bhimsen Joshi belonged, has produced several other legendary musicians and is considered one of the most influential schools of music in India.
 
• His music was marked by his powerful voice, brilliant technique, and soulful renditions, making him one of the most respected and loved classical singers of India.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 1) Agra
 The Agra Gharana focuses on a wide and forceful voice, with an emphasis on the nom-tom alap and bold, forceful execution of khyals.
 
 

 2) Benaras
 The Benaras Gharana is known for its specialization in the thumri genre, as well as in the Khayal and tappa styles, with a focus on laykari (rhythmic play).
 
 

 4) Gwalior
 The Gwalior Gharana, one of the oldest in India, is celebrated for its balanced approach to khayal singing, giving equal importance to both raga and laya (rhythm).
